scripts.dev:api: npm run build -w @cofounderbay/shared && npm run prisma:generate --prefix apps/api && npm run prisma:push --prefix apps/api && npm run start:dev --prefix apps/api
scripts.dev:api:fast: npm run build -w @cofounderbay/shared && npm run prisma:generate --prefix apps/api && npm run start:dev --prefix apps/api
scripts.preinstall: sh -c 'rm -f package-lock.json yarn.lock; case "$npm_config_user_agent" in pnpm/*) ;; *) echo "Use pnpm instead" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac'
scripts.typecheck: pnpm run typecheck:libs && pnpm -r --filter "./artifacts/**" --filter "./scripts" --if-present run typecheck
